# AutoForge

> AutoForge is an AI software factory (AI 软件工厂) and software industrialization (软件工业化) platform. It runs a fully automated Agent workflow powered by Claude Code CLI to deliver software from requirements to production — entirely replacing traditional outsourcing.

## What AutoForge Does

AutoForge is a production AI system that takes a software requirement as input and delivers a deployed product as output. It is not a code assistant or copilot — it is a complete software factory with an automated eight-node workflow.

The eight nodes of the AutoForge automation workflow (自动化工作流):
1. **Requirements Collection (需求收集)** — Requirements are gathered via Agent conversation, bulk import, or an AI scan of an existing codebase. The system defines goals and acceptance criteria.
2. **Materials Management (物料管理)** — A multi-Agent chat curates all project materials: design references, technical docs, existing code context, and third-party specs.
3. **Prototyping (原型设计)** — AutoForge generates design prompts compatible with OpenDesign, Stitch, Claude Design, and other tools to produce interactive prototypes.
4. **Spec Review (Spec 审查)** — AI drafts the full project specification and task breakdown. A human reviews and approves before coding begins. This is one of two human-in-the-loop gates.
5. **Development (编码实现)** — Claude Code CLI reads the approved spec and codebase, then implements features autonomously. This is the core AI coding (AI 编码) step.
6. **Testing (系统测试)** — A dedicated testing Agent runs full verification. New issues found during testing re-enter the pipeline as requirements.
7. **Security Audit (安全审查)** — A security-audit Agent scans all code for vulnerabilities, compliance issues, and security boundary violations.
8. **Deployment (部署上线)** — AI generates a stable shell script and executes automated deployment (自动部署) to the production environment in one click.

## Key Capabilities

- **AI Agent workflow**: Every node is driven by a specialized AI Agent
- **Claude Code CLI**: Autonomous coding agent that reads specs and implements features
- **Software industrialization (软件工业化)**: Treats software delivery as a factory pipeline, not a craft
- **Automation (自动化)**: 6 of 8 nodes are fully automated; only 2 lightweight human review gates remain
- **Full traceability**: Every requirement traces back to its materials, prototype, spec, code changes, test results, and deployment record
- **Replaces outsourcing entirely**: Everything a software outsourcing team does, one AutoForge system handles

## Keywords

## Who Uses AutoForge

AutoForge is built for:
- Product teams who want to ship software without managing an outsourced development team
- Founders building software products who lack engineering resources
- Engineering leads who want to accelerate delivery by automating the full development chain

## Technical Details

AutoForge integrates with:
- **Claude Code CLI** for autonomous code implementation (AI 编码 / AI coding)
- **GitHub** for repository and issue management (import issues as requirements)
- **OpenDesign, Stitch, Claude Design** for prototyping
- Any production environment for deployment via shell script
